# text.patch.json

Apply structural set/delete/merge edits to a JSON file with order + indent preservation

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `backup` | boolean | No | - |
| `delete` | array | No | - |
| `merge` | object | No | - |
| `merge_strategy` | string | No | - |
| `path` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `set` | object | No | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd

- `file.updated`
